statement: This file intentionally distinguishes written policy from implemented and independently verified controls.

status_legend.IMPLEMENTED: Technical or procedural implementation exists but has not been independently verified.

implementation_notes.note: Company governance artifacts, schemas, review templates and CI structural validation are being established in the official corporate repository.
Cross-platform evidence practices exist in XPeX Systems Command, but XAGF-wide continuous assurance is not yet implemented for every system.
Some previously audited Vercel portfolio candidates have unresolved readable-secret findings and remain blocked from public VERIFIED_LIVE promotion until remediated.
